title: Pass on the judgment, not just the answer
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Expose the early evidence — Reconstruct what was known before the outcome.; Compare plausible choices — Name the trade-offs and relevant cues.; Test the reasoning — Ask what evidence would change the action.; Practise a changed case — Vary one condition and revisit the judgment..
